lines: There is someone I want to be loved.
What a luxurious life.
Even though the familiar city is full of unfamiliar faces.
We know each other, the good and the bad.
Our frozen hands, even though the last train is only a little away.
We have so many memories that we never run out of stories.
Meetings gradually change their names.
The person I love, the beloved, even chance—if I call it now, it’s destiny.
If we can name the joy we found and laugh together, let’s call it happiness.
I want to be loved, deep in my heart; even I who longs for love have someone to love.
There is someone I want to be loved, what a luxurious life.
The years pile up between pretense and true feelings.
We have also left behind stories of the past.
Encounters slowly take on new forms.
People I miss but can’t meet, loves I couldn’t call fate.
If we can recall the coldness when our hands slipped apart, let’s turn it into kindness.
I want to be loved, deep in my heart; even I who longs for love have someone to love.
There is someone I want to be loved, what a luxurious life.
Just like this, just like this.
I want to live loving.
Ah, just like this, just like this.
Forever.
To the people living today, I want to sing; a song is born.
Including the joy we found and the feeling when our hands slipped apart.
I want to be loved, deep in my heart; even I who longs for love have someone to love.
There is someone I want to be loved.
Reach, hear, to you.
What a luxurious life.
